label: default agent • add an HTTP MCP server with a token_ref secret reference
query: Add an HTTP MCP server called 'linear' at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp. It needs a bearer token — use the one already in my LINEAR_MCP_TOKEN environment variable, and don't ask me to paste it into chat.
notes: Phase 4 secret-ref scope for MCP: `token_ref: env:LINEAR_MCP_TOKEN` on an HTTP entry. The whole point of the ref grammar is that the secret VALUE never travels through chat; the case pins the ref key and the env: reference string.
